about_short_description.short_description: The Exceptional Home Renting Experience. Powered by AI. Made and Loved by People.

product.name: Belong Property Management Service
product.description: A comprehensive property management service that handles rental home marketing, resident placement, rent collection, maintenance, and resident relations for homeowners.

product.name: Belong Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application that allows homeowners and residents to manage rental homes, pay rent, request maintenance, and communicate with the Belong team.

product.name: Resident Screening and Placement
product.description: A resident vetting process that includes background checks, credit verification, employment confirmation, and personal interviews to ensure reliable tenant placement.

product.name: Guaranteed Rent Program
product.description: A program that guarantees rental payments to homeowners on schedule, regardless of tenant payment status.

product.name: Maintenance and Repair Services
product.description: Ongoing maintenance and repair management including 24/7 emergency services, handled by vetted professionals to maintain rental homes.

product.name: Marketing and Listing Distribution
product.description: Marketing services that include professional photography, 3D virtual walkthroughs, open houses, and distribution of listings across 26 rental websites.
